description: A Multi-City Passive 5G Network Measurement Dataset for Mobility-Aware Wireless Communication Research is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Neethu Sajeev, Oluwakayode Onireti. "Fifth generation (5G) mobile networks require extensive real world measurement datasets to support the development of efficient handover management, mobility prediction, signal analysis, and network optimization techniques. However, publicly available passive 5G datasets collected across different urban environments remain limited. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
